package.description: With MyDrive Insight you get a pc software tool, saving you time and cost in your daily work by reducing complexity.

en-US.description: With MyDrive Insight you get a pc software tool, saving you time and cost in your daily work by reducing complexity.
en-US.longDescription:
The tool helps to support with commissioning and monitoring.

Features include:

- Seamless configuration and commissioning support
- Project management with backup/restore and report generation functionality
- Data-based drives performance insights - device signals, notifications, and drives systems
  performance visualizations based on real-time data
- Enhanced configuration through fieldbus customization, and functional safety interface
- Secure communication – no unauthorized access to your system
en-US.name: MyDrive Insight
